title: ModuleManifest
description: module.yaml — manifest plus declarative rules (SPEC-0 §5.2). Strict: unknown top-level keys are an error, not a warning (REQ MOD-014).

name.description: Slug. Must equal the module directory name and be unique in the library.

pporlock_api.description: Module API major version the module targets (SPEC-0 §8.1). An unsupported value refuses to load with a clear message (REQ MOD-026).

enabled.description: Creating or updating a module never enables it (REQ MCP-030); enabling is a separate explicit action.

priority.description: Lower runs earlier. Orders rules across modules (SPEC-0 §5.4).

config.description: Free-form; the author's defaults. Merged under any declared `settings` the user has changed, then passed to ctx.config (SPEC-0 §8.2).

settings.description: Fields a user may change from the module library without editing this file. Values the user sets are stored in the module-state sidecar and never written back here (module enablement works the same way; OI-8). Deliberately not JSON Schema: everything declarable here renders as exactly one form control. There is no secret type — a value set here is stored and served in clear.

key.description: The key this field sets in ctx.config.

label.description: Shown in the form. Defaults to the key.

default.description: Checked against `type` at load, so a declaration whose own default its field would reject is a load error rather than a form that is invalid the moment it opens.

options.description: Enum choices, required for an enum and meaningless elsewhere. A bare string is shorthand for a value and label of the same text.
